data.topic: 会话1 · Dialogue 1 (Textbook: At the Post Office)

items.py: Hézǐ: Yǒu míngxìnpiàn ma?
items.en: Hezi: Do you have postcards?

items.py: Yíngyèyuán: Yǒu, zhè shì xīn chū de.
items.en: Clerk: Yes, these are newly released.

items.py: Hézǐ: Hái yǒu hǎokàn de ma?
items.en: Hezi: Are there any other nice ones?

items.zh: 营业员：你看看，这几种怎么样？
items.py: Yíngyèyuán: Nǐ kànkan, zhè jǐ zhǒng zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Clerk: Have a look, how about these few kinds?

items.py: Hézǐ: Qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ tiāo jǐ zhǒng.
items.en: Hezi: Please help me pick some.

items.zh: 营业员：我看这四种都很好。
items.py: Yíngyèyuán: Wǒ kàn zhè sì zhǒng dōu hěn hǎo.
items.en: Clerk: I think all four kinds are nice.

items.py: Hézǐ: Nà yī zhǒng mǎi yī tào ba.
items.en: Hezi: Then give me a set of each.

items.py: Yíngyèyuán: Hái mǎi bié de ma?
items.en: Clerk: Anything else?

items.py: Hézǐ: Bù mǎi le.
items.en: Hezi: No, that's all.

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (Textbook: In the Park)

items.py: Hézǐ: Zhège gōngyuán búcuò.
items.en: Hezi: This park is quite nice.

items.zh: 张丽英：那种花儿真好看，我要照张相。
items.py: Zhāng Lìyīng: Nà zhǒng huār zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ yào zhào zhāng xiàng.
items.en: Zhang Liying: Those flowers are really beautiful, I want to take a photo.

items.zh: 和子：给玛丽打个电话，叫她也来吧。
items.py: Hézǐ: Gěi Mǎlì dǎ ge diànhuà, jiào tā yě lái ba.
items.en: Hezi: Call Mary, ask her to come too.

items.zh: 张丽英：哎呀，我的手机没电了。
items.py: Zhāng Lìyīng: Āiyā, wǒ de shǒujī méi diàn le.
items.en: Zhang Liying: Oh no, my phone has no battery.

items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ dǎ ba.
items.en: Hezi: I'll call.

items.zh: 张丽英：好。我去买点儿饮料。
items.py: Zhāng Lìyīng: Hǎo. Wǒ qù mǎi diǎnr yǐnliào.
items.en: Zhang Liying: OK. I'll go buy some drinks.

items.zh: 张丽英：你打通电话了吗？
items.py: Zhāng Lìyīng: Nǐ dǎtōng diànhuà le ma?
items.en: Zhang Liying: Did you get through?

items.py: Hézǐ: Méi dǎtōng, tā guānjī le.
items.en: Hezi: No, her phone is off.

items.zh: 张老师：大卫，你对什么感兴趣？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Dàwèi, nǐ duì shénme gǎn xìngqù?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: David, what are you interested in?

items.zh: 大卫：我对中国文化很感兴趣。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà hěn gǎn xìngqù.
items.en: David: I'm very interested in Chinese culture.

items.zh: 张老师：你喜欢中国画吗？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Nǐ xǐhuan Zhōngguó huà ma?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Do you like Chinese paintings?

items.zh: 大卫：很喜欢。中国画很有意思。
items.py: Dàwèi: Hěn xǐhuan. Zhōngguó huà hěn yǒu yìsi.
items.en: David: Very much. Chinese paintings are very interesting.

items.zh: 张老师：你会不会画中国画？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Nǐ huì bu huì huà Zhōngguó huà?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Can you paint Chinese paintings?

items.zh: 大卫：一点儿也不会。我想学。
items.py: Dàwèi: Yīdiǎnr yě bú huì. Wǒ xiǎng xué.
items.en: David: Not at all. I'd like to learn.

items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Wǒ kěyǐ jiāo nǐ.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: I can teach you.

items.zh: 大卫：太好了！谢谢张老师。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie Zhāng lǎoshī.
items.en: David: Great! Thank you, Teacher Zhang.

items.zh: 大卫：和子，你学汉语学了多长时间了？
items.py: Dàwèi: Hézǐ, nǐ xué Hànyǔ xué le duō cháng shíjiān le?
items.en: David: Hezi, how long have you been studying Chinese?

items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ xué le yī nián le.
items.en: Hezi: I've been studying for a year.

items.zh: 大卫：你的汉语说得很好。
items.py: Dàwèi: Nǐ de Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
items.en: David: You speak Chinese very well.

items.zh: 和子：哪里，说得不太好。你也学了一年吗？
items.py: Hézǐ: Nǎli, shuō de bú tài hǎo. Nǐ yě xué le yī nián ma?
items.en: Hezi: Not really, I don't speak well. Have you also studied for a year?

items.zh: 大卫：没有，我才学了半年。
items.py: Dàwèi: Méiyǒu, wǒ cái xué le bàn nián.
items.en: David: No, I've only studied for half a year.

items.zh: 和子：是吗？你的汉语也不错啊。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì ma? Nǐ de Hànyǔ yě búcuò a.
items.en: Hezi: Really? Your Chinese is also good.

items.zh: 大卫：我每天都练习，可是汉字太难了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ měi tiān dōu liànxí, kěshì Hànzì tài nán le.
items.en: David: I practice every day, but Chinese characters are too hard.

items.zh: 和子：是的，汉字是不太容易。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì de, Hànzì shì bú tài róngyì.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, characters are not so easy.

items.zh: 听后复述：这个照相机是大卫新买的。昨天北京大学的两个中国学生来玩儿，我们一起照相了。北京大学的朋友说，星期天请我们去玩儿。他们在东门等我们。我们去的时候，先给他们打电话。
items.py: Tīng hòu fùshù: Zhège zhàoxiàngjī shì Dàwèi xīn mǎi de. Zuótiān Běijīng Dàxué de liǎng ge Zhōngguó xuéshēng lái wánr, wǒmen yīqǐ zhàoxiàng le. Běijīng Dàxué de péngyou shuō, xīngqītiān qǐng wǒmen qù wánr. Tāmen zài dōngmén děng wǒmen. Wǒmen qù de shíhou, xiān gěi tāmen dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: Listen & retell: This camera was newly bought by David. Yesterday two Chinese students from Peking University came to hang out, and we took photos together. Our friends at PKU said they'd invite us to hang out on Sunday. They'll wait for us at the east gate. We should call them first when we go.
